sources.title: Evo 1.5 8k Base - biolm.ai
sources.snippet: Evo 1.5 8k Base is a 7B-parameter autoregressive genomic language model trained on ~300B nucleotides from prokaryotic genomes with 8,192-token context at single-nucleotide resolution.
